# Programa en pantuflas

## La programación empieza por los pies.

Quizás no te hayas dado cuenta de lo mucho que tenemos en común.

Da igual la profesión, el país de origen o la lengua que hables.

Si trabajas o disfrutas frente a una pantalla muy probablemente lo hagas igual que yo y otros muchos malandriners. Estarás en pantuflas.

Zapatillas de andar por casa, chancletas, calcetines gordos... Incluso descalzo.

Cualquiera de esas opciones es ·estar *"en pantuflas"*.

Los tiempos en la programación están cambiando. Muy rápido.

La inteligencia artificial ha llegado para quedarse y no hay vuelta atrás.

Antes, la mayor parte de nuestro tiempo la pasábamos picando código. Ahora, cada vez más, lo pasamos viendo cómo una máquina escribe ese código. Y lo hace cada vez mejor.

Es tiempo de adaptarse. De vivir un poquito más incómodos por la incertidumbre que generan todos estos cambios.

Pero también más esperanzados.

🔥 **Es una incertidumbre emocionante.** Porque ahora, por fin, podemos hacer todo aquello que habíamos soñado. Solo es cuestión de saber qué es lo que quieres hacer.

---

## Web Reactiva, programa con IA

Web Reactiva nació en septiembre de 2017 como un podcast donde yo contaba las cosas que iba aprendiendo.

Mis primeros frameworks de frontend (yo siempre venía del backend). Mis primeras peleas con bots web, sin inteligencia artificial, solo con reglas para que respondieran. Mis primeros pasos con Docker. Cosas así.

Y ha vuelto otra vez a ser lo que fue en origen. O quizás lo que nunca dejó de ser: **un sitio donde contar las cosas que estoy aprendiendo.**

Ahora hemos dado un giro. Web Reactiva tiene apellido: **Web Reactiva, programa con IA.** Hablamos de programación asistida con inteligencia artificial, de herramientas, de modelos. Pero sobre todo, sin perder el eslogan que siempre hemos tenido:

**La tecnología es necesaria, pero las personas somos lo importante.**

Aquí encontrarás tutoriales, guías y pruebas de herramientas. Pero también escucharás a personas que, como tú, tienen que enfrentarse a este cambio y adoptar una tecnología disruptiva en un momento en el que nadie pensaba que su vida profesional iba a cambiar tanto.

**Da igual el nivel que tengas, lleves años o estés justo empezando. A pesar de tener tecnologías tan avanzadas, seguimos programando en pantuflas.**

> Si un día, aunque fuera solo un minuto, algo de lo que aquí hemos contado en Web Reactiva ha servido para inspirarte y empujarte a dar un salto más allá de tus límites, me doy por contento.

Soy Dani Primo y si quieres seguir disfrutando en pantuflas, apúntate a mi newsletter justo aquí debajo ;)

            const gain = audioContext.createGain();
            oscillator.type = type === 'fail' ? 'sawtooth' : 'sine';
            oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(frequency, now + index * .075);

          y = slot[1] + (Math.random() - .5) * .05;
        }
        const instance = { id: createInstanceId(), element: elementId, x: clamp(x, .09, .91), y: clamp(y, .10, .90) };
        state.instances.push(instance);
        const node = createNode(instance, options.animate !== false, options.isNew);
        renderEmptyState();
        if (options.persist !== false) saveState();
        return { instance, node };
      }

      function removeInstance(id, persist = true) {
        const index = state.instances.findIndex(item => item.id === id);
        if (index === -1) return;
        state.instances.splice(index, 1);
        getNode(id)?.remove();
        if (selectedId === id) selectedId = null;
        renderEmptyState();
        if (persist) saveState();
      }

      function renderEmptyState() {
        $('#emptyLab').hidden = state.instances.length > 0;
      }

      function startNodePointer(event, id) {
        if (event.button !== 0 || event.target.closest('.node-remove')) return;
        const instance = getInstance(id);
        const node = getNode(id);
        if (!instance || !node) return;
        event.preventDefault();
        node.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
        dragState = {
          id, pointerId: event.pointerId, startClientX: event.clientX, startClientY: event.clientY,
          originalX: instance.x, originalY: instance.y, moved: false, targetId: null
        };
      }

      function moveNodePointer(event) {
        if (!dragState || dragState.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
        const distance = Math.hypot(event.clientX - dragState.startClientX, event.clientY - dragState.startClientY);
        if (!dragState.moved && distance < 5) return;
        dragState.moved = true;
        const instance = getInstance(dragState.id);
        const node = getNode(dragState.id);
        if (!instance || !node) return;
        const rect = board.getBoundingClientRect();
        instance.x = clamp(dragState.originalX + (event.clientX - dragState.startClientX) / rect.width, .07, .93);
        instance.y = clamp(dragState.originalY + (event.clientY - dragState.startClientY) / rect.height, .08, .92);
        node.style.left = `${instance.x * 100}%`;
        node.style.top = `${instance.y * 100}%`;
        node.classList.add('dragging');
        node.classList.remove('selected');
        clearCombineTargets();
        dragState.targetId = findCombineTarget(dragState.id);
        if (dragState.targetId) getNode(dragState.targetId)?.classList.add('combine-target');
      }

      function endNodePointer(event) {
        if (!dragState || dragState.pointerId !== event.pointerId) return;
        const currentDrag = dragState;
        dragState = null;
        const node = getNode(currentDrag.id);
        node?.classList.remove('dragging');
        clearCombineTargets();
        if (currentDrag.moved) {
          if (currentDrag.targetId && getInstance(currentDrag.targetId)) {
            combineInstances(currentDrag.id, currentDrag.targetId);
          } else {
            if (selectedId === currentDrag.id) node?.classList.add('selected');
            saveState();
          }
        } else {
          handleNodeClick(currentDrag.id);
        }
      }

      function cancelNodePointer() {
        if (!dragState) return;
        const instance = getInstance(dragState.id);
        const node = getNode(dragState.id);
        if (instance && node) {
          instance.x = dragState.originalX;
          instance.y = dragState.originalY;
          node.style.left = `${instance.x * 100}%`;
          node.style.top = `${instance.y * 100}%`;
          node.classList.remove('dragging');
        }
        dragState = null;
        clearCombineTargets();
      }

      function clearCombineTargets() { boardNodes.querySelectorAll('.combine-target').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('combine-target')); }

      function findCombineTarget(sourceId) {
        const sourceNode = getNode(sourceId);
        if (!sourceNode) return null;
        const sourceRect = sourceNode.getBoundingClientRect();
        const sourceX = sourceRect.left + sourceRect.width / 2;
        const sourceY = sourceRect.top + sourceRect.height / 2;
        let nearest = null;
        let nearestDistance = Infinity;
        state.instances.forEach(instance => {
          if (instance.id === sourceId) return;
          const node = getNode(instance.id);
          if (!node) return;
          const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
          const distance = Math.hypot(sourceX - (rect.left + rect.width / 2), sourceY - (rect.top + rect.height / 2));
          const threshold = Math.min(118, (sourceRect.width + rect.width) * .40);
          if (distance < threshold && distance < nearestDistance) {
            nearest = instance.id;
            nearestDistance = distance;
          }
        });
        return nearest;
      }

      function handleNodeClick(id) {
        if (!getInstance(id)) return;
        if (!selectedId) {
          selectedId = id;
          boardNodes.querySelectorAll('.selected').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('selected'));
          getNode(id)?.classList.add('selected');
          playSound('pop');
          return;
        }
        if (selectedId === id) {
          selectedId = null;
          getNode(id)?.classList.remove('selected');
          return;
        }
        const firstId = selectedId;
        selectedId = null;
        getNode(firstId)?.classList.remove('selected');
        combineInstances(firstId, id);
      }

      function combineInstances(firstId, secondId) {
        const first = getInstance(firstId);
        const second = getInstance(secondId);
        if (!first || !second || first.id === second.id) return;
        const resultId = getRecipe(first.element, second.element);
        const firstNode = getNode(firstId);
        const secondNode = getNode(secondId);
        if (!resultId) {
          [firstNode, secondNode].forEach(node => {
            node?.classList.remove('shake');
            requestAnimationFrame(() => node?.classList.add('shake'));
            setTimeout(() => node?.classList.remove('shake'), 450);
          });
          if (dragState === null && firstNode) {
            firstNode.style.left = `${first.x * 100}%`;
            firstNode.style.top = `${first.y * 100}%`;
          }
          playSound('fail');
          showToast('Sin reacción', FAIL_MESSAGES[state.totalCombines % FAIL_MESSAGES.length], 'error', '🧪');
          $('#announcer').textContent = 'Estos elementos no se pueden combinar.';
          return;
        }

        const x = (first.x + second.x) / 2;
        const y = (first.y + second.y) / 2;
        const ingredients = [ELEMENTS[first.element], ELEMENTS[second.element]];
        const recipeKey = [first.element, second.element].sort().join('|');
        removeInstance(firstId, false);
        removeInstance(secondId, false);
        const isNew = !state.discovered.includes(resultId);
        state.totalCombines++;
        if (!state.history.includes(recipeKey)) state.history.push(recipeKey);
        if (isNew) {
          state.discovered.push(resultId);
          state.latest = resultId;
        }
        const spawned = spawnElement(resultId, x, y, { isNew, persist: false });
        saveState();
        renderAllPanels();
        playSound(isNew ? 'discovery' : 'combine');
        if (spawned) {
          burstAtNode(spawned.node, isNew ? 16 : 9);
          spawned.node.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        }

        const result = ELEMENTS[resultId];
        if (isNew) {
          showToast('Nuevo descubrimiento', result.name, 'discovery', result.icon, `${ingredients[0].icon} ${ingredients[0].name} + ${ingredients[1].icon} ${ingredients[1].name}`, result.description);
          $('#announcer').textContent = `Nuevo descubrimiento: ${result.name}. ${result.description}`;
          checkMilestone();
        } else {
          $('#announcer').textContent = `Has creado ${result.name}.`;
        }
      }

      function burstAtNode(node, count) {
        if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
        const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
        const colors = ['#e86f5c', '#9174c9', '#e9ad45', '#4f8c72'];
        for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
          const particle = document.createElement('span');
          const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i / count) + Math.random() * .3;
          const distance = 40 + Math.random() * 55;
          particle.className = 'particle';
          particle.style.left = `${rect.left + rect.width / 2}px`;
          particle.style.top = `${rect.top + rect.height / 2}px`;
          particle.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
          particle.style.setProperty('--dx', `${Math.cos(angle) * distance}px`);
          particle.style.setProperty('--dy', `${Math.sin(angle) * distance}px`);
          particle.style.setProperty('--rot', `${Math.random() * 300}deg`);
          document.body.appendChild(particle);
          setTimeout(() => particle.remove(), 750);
        }
      }

      function celebrate() {
        if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
        const colors = ['#e86f5c', '#9174c9', '#e9ad45', '#4f8c72', '#f5c7b9'];
        for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
          const piece = document.createElement('span');
          piece.className = 'confetti';
          piece.style.left = `${Math.random() * 100}vw`;
          piece.style.background = colors[i % colors.length];
          piece.style.setProperty('--drift', `${(Math.random() - .5) * 260}px`);
          piece.style.setProperty('--duration', `${1.8 + Math.random() * 1.8}s`);
          piece.style.animationDelay = `${Math.random() * .35}s`;
          document.body.appendChild(piece);
          setTimeout(() => piece.remove(), 4000);
        }
      }

      function checkMilestone() {
        const count = state.discovered.length;
        const reached = MILESTONES.filter(milestone => count >= milestone && !state.celebrated.includes(milestone));
        if (!reached.length) return;
        state.celebrated.push(...reached);
        saveState();
        celebrate();
        const level = getLevel();
        setTimeout(() => showToast('¡Nuevo rango!', level.name, 'discovery', level.icon, `${count} elementos descubiertos`, 'Tu laboratorio malandriner sube de nivel.'), 650);
      }

      function getLevel() {
        return [...LEVELS].reverse().find(level => state.discovered.length >= level.at) || LEVELS[0];
      }

      function showToast(kicker, title, type = 'info', icon = '🧪', formula = '', description = '') {
        const toast = document.createElement('div');
        toast.className = `toast ${type === 'error' ? 'error' : ''}`;
        toast.innerHTML = `<div class="toast-icon" aria-hidden="true">${icon}</div><div class="toast-copy"><div class="toast-kicker">${kicker}</div><div class="toast-title">${title}</div>${formula ? `<div class="toast-description">${formula}</div>` : ''}${description ? `<div class="toast-description">${description}</div>` : ''}</div><button class="toast-close" aria-label="Cerrar notificación">×</button>`;
        const remove = () => {
          if (!toast.isConnected || toast.classList.contains('leaving')) return;
          toast.classList.add('leaving');
          setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 260);
        };
        toast.querySelector('.toast-close').addEventListener('click', remove);
        toastRegion.replaceChildren(toast);
        setTimeout(remove, type === 'error' ? 3200 : 4800);
      }

      function renderAllPanels() {
        renderInventory();
        renderJournal();
        renderProgress();
      }

      function renderInventory() {
        let ids = state.discovered.filter(id => {
          const element = ELEMENTS[id];
          const haystack = normalizeText(`${element.name} ${CATEGORY_NAMES[element.category] || ''}`);
          return haystack.includes(normalizeText(searchQuery));
        });
        if (state.sort === 'alpha') ids.sort((a, b) => ELEMENTS[a].name.localeCompare(ELEMENTS[b].name, 'es'));
        else ids = [...ids].reverse();
        inventory.innerHTML = '';
        if (!ids.length) {
          inventory.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-search"><span>🔎</span>No encontramos ese elemento.<br>Quizá todavía esté por descubrir.<button id="resetSearch">Borrar búsqueda</button></div>`;
          $('#resetSearch').addEventListener('click', clearSearch);
        } else {
          ids.forEach(id => {
            const element = ELEMENTS[id];
            const button = document.createElement('button');
            button.className = `inventory-item${BASE_IDS.includes(id) ? ' base' : ''}${state.latest === id ? ' latest' : ''}`;
            button.draggable = true;
            button.dataset.element = id;
            button.title = `${element.description}\nCategoría: ${CATEGORY_NAMES[element.category]}`;
            button.setAttribute('aria-label', `${element.name}. Añadir a la mesa.`);
            button.innerHTML = `<span class="inventory-emoji" aria-hidden="true">${element.icon}</span><span class="inventory-name">${element.name}</span>`;
            button.addEventListener('click', () => {
              if (draggedInventoryId) return;
              spawnElement(id);
              playSound('pop');
            });
            button.addEventListener('dragstart', event => {
              draggedInventoryId = id;
              event.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', id);
              event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'copy';
            });
            button.addEventListener('dragend', () => {
              setTimeout(() => { draggedInventoryId = null; }, 0);
              board.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            inventory.appendChild(button);
          });
        }
        $('#elementsTabCount').textContent = state.discovered.length;
        $('#sortLabel').textContent = state.sort === 'alpha' ? 'A–Z' : 'Recientes';
        $('#searchClear').hidden = !searchQuery;
        const remaining = Object.keys(ELEMENTS).length - state.discovered.length;
        $('#collectionFooter').innerHTML = remaining
          ? `<strong>${remaining} elementos</strong> esperan una reacción. Sigue experimentando.`
          : '<strong>¡Colección completada!</strong> Eres una leyenda malandriner 🏆';
      }

      function renderJournal() {
        const list = $('#journalList');
        $('#journalTabCount').textContent = state.history.length;
        if (!state.history.length) {
          list.innerHTML = '<div class="journal-empty"><span class="empty-book">📓</span><h3>Aún no hay reacciones</h3><p>Tu primera receta aparecerá aquí.<br>Prueba con 💻 Código + ✨ IA.</p></div>';
          return;
        }
        list.innerHTML = '';
        [...state.history].reverse().forEach(key => {
          const [aId, bId] = key.split('|');
          const resultId = RECIPES[key];
          if (!ELEMENTS[aId] || !ELEMENTS[bId] || !ELEMENTS[resultId]) return;
          const a = ELEMENTS[aId];
          const b = ELEMENTS[bId];
          const result = ELEMENTS[resultId];
          const entry = document.createElement('div');
          entry.className = 'journal-entry';
          entry.innerHTML = `<div><div class="journal-result"><span>${result.icon}</span>${result.name}</div><div class="journal-formula">${a.icon} ${a.name} + ${b.icon} ${b.name}</div></div><button class="journal-repeat" aria-label="Repetir receta de ${result.name}" title="Soltar ingredientes en la mesa"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"><path d="M20 11a8 8 0 1 0-2 5.3M20 4v7h-7"/></svg></button>`;
          entry.querySelector('button').addEventListener('click', () => {
            spawnElement(aId);
            spawnElement(bId);
            playSound('pop');
          });
          list.appendChild(entry);
        });
      }

      function renderProgress() {
        const count = state.discovered.length;
        const total = Object.keys(ELEMENTS).length;
        const percent = count / total * 100;
        $('#discoveredCount').textContent = count;
        $('#totalCount').textContent = total;
        $('#progressFill').style.width = `${percent}%`;
        $('#progressTrack').setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(Math.round(percent)));
        const level = getLevel();
        $('#levelIcon').textContent = level.icon;
        $('#levelName').textContent = level.name;
        const quest = QUESTS.find(([id]) => !state.discovered.includes(id));
        $('#missionTarget').textContent = quest ? quest[1] : (count === total ? '🏆 Universo completado' : '✨ Explora tu propio camino');
      }

        const available = RECIPE_LIST.filter(recipe => !state.discovered.includes(recipe.result) && state.discovered.includes(recipe.a) && state.discovered.includes(recipe.b));
        const hintCard = $('#hintCard');
        if (!available.length) {
          const remaining = Object.keys(ELEMENTS).length - state.discovered.length;
          showToast(remaining ? 'Pistas agotadas' : '¡Lo has descubierto todo!', remaining ? 'Prueba a combinar tus descubrimientos más recientes.' : 'No queda ningún elemento por encontrar. Enhorabuena, malandriner.', 'discovery', remaining ? '🧭' : '🏆');
          return;
        }
        const recipe = available[0];
        const a = ELEMENTS[recipe.a];
        const b = ELEMENTS[recipe.b];
        $('#hintFormula').innerHTML = `<span>${a.icon} ${a.name}</span><span>+</span><span>${b.icon} ${b.name}</span><span class="formula-arrow">→</span><span>❔</span><button class="hint-use" id="useHint">Soltar en la mesa</button>`;
        $('#useHint').addEventListener('click', () => {
          spawnElement(recipe.a);
          spawnElement(recipe.b);
          hintCard.hidden = true;
          playSound('pop');
        });
        hintCard.hidden = false;
        playSound('pop');

        searchQuery = '';
        $('#searchInput').value = '';
        renderInventory();
        $('#searchInput').focus();

        const elementsActive = view === 'elements';
        $('#elementsView').hidden = !elementsActive;
        $('#journalView').hidden = elementsActive;
        $('#elementsTab').classList.toggle('active', elementsActive);
        $('#journalTab').classList.toggle('active', !elementsActive);
        $('#elementsTab').setAttribute('aria-selected', String(elementsActive));
        $('#journalTab').setAttribute('aria-selected', String(!elementsActive));
      }

        state = defaultState();
        selectedId = null;
        searchQuery = '';
        spawnCounter = 0;
        boardNodes.innerHTML = '';
        $('#searchInput').value = '';
        $('#hintCard').hidden = true;
        saveState();
        renderEmptyState();
        renderAllPanels();
        updateSoundButton();
        switchView('elements');
        $('#resetDialog').close();
        showToast('Laboratorio reiniciado', 'Cuatro elementos. Infinitas posibilidades.', 'discovery', '🩴');
      }

      board.addEventListener('dragover', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'copy';
        board.classList.add('drag-over');
      });
      board.addEventListener('dragleave', event => {
        if (!board.contains(event.relatedTarget)) board.classList.remove('drag-over');
      });
      board.addEventListener('drop', event => {
        event.preventDefault();
        board.classList.remove('drag-over');
        const id = event.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain') || draggedInventoryId;
        if (!ELEMENTS[id] || !state.discovered.includes(id)) return;
        const rect = board.getBoundingClientRect();
        spawnElement(id, (event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width, (event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height);
        draggedInventoryId = null;
        playSound('pop');
      });
      board.addEventListener('pointerdown', event => {
        if (event.target === board || event.target === boardNodes) {
          selectedId = null;
          boardNodes.querySelectorAll('.selected').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('selected'));
        }
      });

      $('#starterMix').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const first = spawnElement('code', .35, .50);
        const second = spawnElement('ai', .58, .50);
        playSound('pop');
        if (first && second) setTimeout(() => combineInstances(first.instance.id, second.instance.id), 420);
      });
      $('#clearButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
        if (!state.instances.length) {
          showToast('La mesa ya está despejada', 'Todo listo para tu próximo experimento.', 'error', '🧹');
          return;
        }
        state.instances = [];
        selectedId = null;
        boardNodes.innerHTML = '';
        renderEmptyState();
        saveState();
        playSound('pop');
      });
      $('#hintButton').addEventListener('click', showHint);
      $('#hintClose').addEventListener('click', () => { $('#hintCard').hidden = true; });
      $('#searchInput').addEventListener('input', event => { searchQuery = event.target.value; renderInventory(); });
      $('#searchClear').addEventListener('click', clearSearch);
      $('#sortButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.sort = state.sort === 'recent' ? 'alpha' : 'recent';
        saveState();
        renderInventory();
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.collection-tab').forEach(tab => tab.addEventListener('click', () => switchView(tab.dataset.view)));
      $('#soundButton').addEventListener('click', () => {
        state.sound = !state.sound;
        updateSoundButton();
        saveState();
        if (state.sound) playSound('discovery');
      });
      $('#helpButton').addEventListener('click', () => $('#helpDialog').showModal());
      $('#resetButton').addEventListener('click', () => $('#resetDialog').showModal());
      $('#confirmReset').addEventListener('click', resetGame);
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-close-dialog]').forEach(button => button.addEventListener('click', () => $(`#${button.dataset.closeDialog}`).close()));
      document.querySelectorAll('dialog').forEach(dialog => dialog.addEventListener('click', event => {
        if (event.target === dialog) {
          const rect = dialog.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (event.clientX < rect.left || event.clientX > rect.right || event.clientY < rect.top || event.clientY > rect.bottom) dialog.close();
        }
      }));
      document.addEventListener('keydown', event => {
        const typing = ['INPUT', 'TEXTAREA'].includes(document.activeElement?.tagName);
        if (event.key === '/' && !typing) {
          event.preventDefault();
          switchView('elements');
          $('#searchInput').focus();
        } else if (event.key.toLowerCase() === 'h' && !typing && !document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
          event.preventDefault();
          showHint();
        } else if (event.key === 'Escape' && !document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) {
          selectedId = null;
          boardNodes.querySelectorAll('.selected').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('selected'));
          $('#hintCard').hidden = true;
        } else if ((event.key === 'Delete' || event.key === 'Backspace') && selectedId && !typing) {
          event.preventDefault();
          removeInstance(selectedId);
        }
      });
      window.addEventListener('resize', () => { selectedId = null; boardNodes.querySelectorAll('.selected').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('selected')); });

      loadState();
      state.instances.forEach(instance => createNode(instance));
      renderEmptyState();
      renderAllPanels();
      updateSoundButton();
      // API mínima para verificar la lógica sin alterar la experiencia de juego.
      window.AlquimiaReactiva = Object.freeze({
        getStats: () => ({ elements: Object.keys(ELEMENTS).length, recipes: RECIPE_LIST.length, discovered: state.discovered.length, instances: state.instances.length }),
        validate: () => {
          const duplicateKeys = RECIPE_LIST.length - new Set(RECIPE_LIST.map(recipe => recipe.key)).size;
          const missing = RECIPE_LIST.flatMap(recipe => [recipe.a, recipe.b, recipe.result]).filter(id => !ELEMENTS[id]);
          const reachable = new Set(BASE_IDS);
          let changed = true;
          while (changed) {
            changed = false;
            RECIPE_LIST.forEach(recipe => {
              if (reachable.has(recipe.a) && reachable.has(recipe.b) && !reachable.has(recipe.result)) { reachable.add(recipe.result); changed = true; }
            });
          }
          return { duplicateKeys, missing, unreachable: Object.keys(ELEMENTS).filter(id => !reachable.has(id)) };
        }
      });
    })();
  </script>
